text:
Anna K: kicking off Custora finetune bring-up — quick eval pack ran overnight. seeing a weird drop on account-classification F1 for short-context prompts. attaching brief: /s/quickpacks/custora/pack-5312349870
Mike R: saw that. merged the customer's LoRA weights into the 7B-base but tokenizer alignment looks off (some tokens mapped to <unk>). suspect token id shift from their zip of vocab.
Raj P: ran int4 quant smoke on the merged model — latency improved ~3x but short-answer accuracy down ~11%. summary: acc_full=0.78 -> acc_quant=0.69. logs: http://ci.internal/runs/5312349888
Sophia L: can we try warm-start merging rather than hard-apply? suggestion: 1) merge-only (no tokenizer change) 2) warm-start finetune 5k steps lr=5e-5 3) full tokenizer-reserve + finetune. keep eval pack constant.
Anna K: data note — customer uses tokens like "CustProd:" and "AcctID#" heavily. if tokenizer remaps, downstream normalization breaks. prefer reserving those tokens if possible. @Mike R any quick way to reserve without full vocab rebuild?
Mike R: short answer: yes, we can inject special tokens mapping using tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": ["CustProd:", "AcctID#"]}) then resize_token_embeddings in the model. quick patch I used below:
```
# patch snippet
specials = ["CustProd:", "AcctID#"]
tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": specials})
model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))
# warm-start steps
```
Raj P: ran the three arms overnight on r5 cluster with caching disabled. results (short):
- merge-only: F1=0.76 latency=120ms
- warm-start: F1=0.80 latency=150ms
- full-reserve+finetune: F1=0.83 latency=170ms
EvalBot: automated-eval summary for thread 5312349870:
- baseline (cust dev): F1=0.85
- merge-only: delta F1 -0.09
- warm-start: delta F1 -0.05
- full-reserve: delta F1 -0.02
- quant int4 (warm-start): delta F1 -0.11, hallucination_rate +0.02
Report: /s/quickpacks/custora/results/5312349870/report.html
Sophia L: takeaway — warm-start looks like best tradeoff for now. quant still risky for short-answer tasks; consider mixed-precision or partial quant on feed-forward. also add token-reserve to rollout checklist.
Anna K: action items:
- Mike R: prepare warm-start merge pipeline with special-token injection and checkpointing (ETA end of day)
- Raj P: run a focused hallucination eval on warm-start+int8 (if available) and run ablation on prompt lengths (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Sophia L: update rollout doc and add fallback policy: if F1 drops >0.04 in canary, auto-fallback to pre-merge model.
- EvalBot: attach final numeric tables and link to canary dashboards.
Mike R: acked. I'll push a small dev patch and post the pipeline run id. :thumbsup:
Raj P: spinning up int8 job now, will post logs.
Anna K: thanks team — ping me if we hit token collisions or OOM during warm-start. :wave:
